findings.message: The `landing()` rewrite only runs inside `guarded`, and `guarded` exists only when DATABASE_URL is set. With no database (the guest preview), `proxy()` returns `NextResponse.next()` before the rewrite, so a signed-out visitor at `/` gets the app overview instead of the marketing page. AC-1 says a signed-out `/` serves the marketing page, and AC-2 says the page renders without a database. landing.spec only runs in the auth config, which has a database, so it never sees this case. Fix: call `landing(req.nextUrl, false)` before the `!guarded` early return, or record in change.md that the guest preview keeps the app at `/` on purpose.
findings.scenario: DATABASE_URL unset, GET / → the app's guest overview (rail, top bar), not the page whose heading is "Agents keep the records. People decide."

findings.message: The 062 mock section, which is the spec for this screen, describes a 40-second video with a 0–40 s storyboard ("Product video, 40 seconds"). The shipped video is 35 s: amax-product.en.vtt ends at 00:00:35 and ProductVideo.tsx's aria-label says "35 seconds". The mock's chat chip also says "Live preview", but the page shows a static "Preview". The mock and the code disagree. Both are inside AC-5's 30–45 s range, so this is a docs mismatch. Fix the mock in its own small change (the mock is read-only during a build).
findings.scenario: Mock 062 says "Product video, 40 seconds" → shipped /welcome video is 35 s

findings.message: The AC-3 'no Coming feature named' guard checks only the hero, description, live claims and steps. It skips the other public copy on the same page: Problem, Trust POINTS, ChatPreview TURNS, the ProductVideo figcaption, the metadata TITLE and the shipped captions (amax-product.en.vtt). The captions already contain a Coming word: 'AMX-142 Export the invoice list to CSV' matches the 'invoic' word for Contracts and billing. marketing-confirm.test.ts has the same gap. Fix: export the remaining copy (Trust, ChatPreview, Problem, figcaption, VTT text) and add it to both `prose`/`surfaces` tables. Then reword the caption's commit message, or accept it explicitly as a fictional client task.
findings.scenario: Change a Trust point to 'Payroll-ready audit' or a caption to 'amax raises the invoice' → both tests still pass, and the public page claims a Coming feature
